Topology.title: Hybrid Cloud for Finance
Topology.Description: Set up a hybrid cloud environment with Azure Red Hat OpenShift and secure connection to on-premises datacenter.
Topology.Summary: The topology includes an Azure VNet with a Red Hat OpenShift cluster, a central firewall, and a private connection to the on-premises datacenter.

Control.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management System' and an 'Asset Inventory Database', which suggests that an asset inventory is being maintained.

Control.title: Document Data Flows
Control.Evidence: The topology includes multiple data flow links (e.g., 'nl4', 'nl5', 'nl6', 'nl7') and peering links (e.g., 'zl3', 'zl4', 'zl5', 'zl6') that document data flows between different zones and nodes.

Control.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
Control.Evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for 'Sensitive Data Zone' (z4) and 'Non-Sensitive Data Zone' (z5), with specific data flow links (e.g., 'nl_new7', 'nl_new8', 'nl_new9', 'nl_new10', 'nl_new11', 'nl_new12') that indicate segmentation based on data sensitivity.

Control.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Central Firewall' (n2) and an 'On-Premises Firewall' (n3), which are explicitly labeled as firewalls and are connected to various zones and nodes.

Control.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n8) and multiple DNS resolution links (e.g., 'nl4', 'nl5', 'nl_new16') that indicate the configuration of trusted DNS servers.

Control.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' (n11) and a link (nl10) labeled 'MFA for remote access', indicating that MFA is required for remote network access.

Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filter' (n9) and multiple DNS filtering links (e.g., 'nl6', 'nl7', 'nl_new17') that indicate the use of DNS filtering services.

Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n10) and multiple web proxy links (e.g., 'nl8', 'nl9') that suggest the enforcement of network-based URL filters.

Control.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
